footer.brand: Thinking is useful, but it is easy to become a prisoner of your own thoughts. You can read hundreds of books, know thousands of quotes and lecture others while remaining trapped in your own illusions. When every conversation becomes a lecture and every person an audience, knowledge stops helping you understand reality and starts feeding your ego. What matters to me is not how convincingly someone talks about the world, but whether their words hold up in reality.
